title: testing whisperx in a music vid w latest UI/visuals in my game
author: AlgaeNo3373
selftext: Making an experimental / artistic 3D LLM visualizer with a combination of many different AI workflows (Claude Code, Astra, Suno). I've been looking into whisperx-powered fun for subtitling, NPC voice acted dialogue etc. Still a WIP. This typography is done by Astra after 2 shots. I'm just dipping my toe in atm before I commit to a plan. I wanna incorporate it in-game via NPC dialogue and any music with lyrics that plays in-game, pretty much like you see here. I will be working on the voice-acted NPC dialogues/subtitling application next so will return when / if that's working! :P
